title: add RAG agent quickstarts, templates, and tool-calling examples; docs site updates
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: provide curated, production-oriented quickstarts and templates for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) agents and tool-calling examples so developers can onboard faster and avoid common pitfalls. This PR adds complete quickstarts (Python and TypeScript), a set of opinionated RAG templates, agent/tool-calling sample apps, and the associated docs site navigation and examples gallery updates.

What changed: - New quickstarts: quickstarts/rag-agent-python, quickstarts/rag-agent-typescript with step-by-step guides, minimal sample repos, and a recommended prompt/template. - RAG templates: docs/reference/rag-templates.md describing template variants (chunking, metadata filters, source attribution, caching knobs). - Tool-calling examples: examples/tool-calling/* with sample tool adapter interfaces and a small local 'calculator' and 'search' tool used in the demos. - Docs site: sidebar updated, new 'Examples' gallery page with live code snippets, and improved API docs links to the Redwood SDKs. - CI: added examples unit tests and a docs smoke test to catch broken code samples.

Checklist: - [x] Add Python quickstart and sample app - [x] Add TypeScript quickstart and sample app - [x] Add RAG templates doc and examples - [x] Update docs navigation and gallery - [x] Add tests for examples and docs build - [x] Confirm that samples use Redwood SDK v1.4 compatibility notes

Notes / guidance: the RAG templates page includes pragmatic recommendations for chunk size, vector store selection, and when to use caching vs. streaming. The quickstarts intentionally use a small local vector store (sqlite + faiss-lite) for reproducibility in CI and as a starting point for users. The tool-calling examples demonstrate both synchronous and streaming tool invocations and include error handling best practices.

Related: ENG-5123 (RAG onboarding), PM-248 (doc experience), SUP-1023 (support playbook for agent misconfiguration).
